items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I went up to Schillinger, called up to see if he would take me on... So I stuck with it, stuck it out

ctx.x: Well, I didn't know particularly how to get started on this. I'd never done this type of music. My bag was working with a dance orchestra. And the dance orchestras were going out of existence. We're coming now into radio.

So I remember to getting one job after another, and some of these little jobs, you could get a whole -- you could get a whole detective story job to do, and, you know, make yourself an income at least for 13, 26 or 39 weeks, as long as it was on, and all you had to do was make noises, naturally, behind what was going on, instrumental noises or whatever.
